scenarios.name: Experimental Model Succeeds
scenarios.description: Candidate completes cleanly; results logged alongside authoritative baseline

scenarios.name: Experimental Model Fails (Exception Injection)
scenarios.description: Candidate throws runtime exception; baseline output immediately returned to user
scenarios.error_caught: Simulated Candidate Model Core Dump / GPU Out Of Memory

scenarios.name: Experimental Model Times Out (> SLA Limit)
scenarios.description: Candidate exceeds SLA; timeout recorded; baseline evaluation unblocked and delivered

scenarios.name: Experimental Model Returns Invalid Output
scenarios.description: Candidate returns malformed JSON; schema validator rejects candidate; baseline served

scenarios.name: Experimental Model Unavailable / Uninitialized
scenarios.description: Candidate checkpoint missing; harness bypasses candidate; baseline-only execution proceeds

scenarios.name: Shadow Logger Fails (I/O Fault Injection)
scenarios.description: Logging layer crashes; baseline evaluation pipeline remains completely unaffected
scenarios.logging_error_caught: Simulated ENOSPC: No space left on device while writing shadow log

scenarios.name: Both Models Disagree (Prediction Divergence)
scenarios.description: Candidate and baseline disagree; disagreement flagged for human review; candidate NOT auto-selected
